mappings.title: Audit Record Generation
mappings.relationship: Audit-daemon status is partial supporting evidence; event selection, record content and full audit coverage are not established.

mappings.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
mappings.relationship: Integrity-tool advice is partial supporting evidence; organization-defined scope, verification and response are not established.

mappings.title: Audit Record Generation
mappings.relationship: Availability of Linux process-accounting data is partial supporting evidence for audit record generation; which events are captured and retained is not established.

mappings.title: Audit Record Generation
mappings.relationship: Sysstat accounting-data availability is partial supporting evidence for audit record generation; coverage and retention are not established.

mappings.title: Audit Record Generation
mappings.relationship: Remote syslog configuration is partial supporting evidence for audit record generation/transport; log content, retention, and protection are not separately verified.

mappings.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
mappings.relationship: Password-file consistency (pwck) is partial supporting evidence for information integrity; it checks one specific file, not general software/firmware integrity.

mappings.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
mappings.relationship: debsums (package-checksum verification utility) presence is partial supporting evidence for information integrity; whether it is actually run on a schedule is checked by a separate, unrelated test.

mappings.title: Authenticator Management
mappings.relationship: Password hashing-round configuration is partial supporting evidence for authenticator management; broader password-policy requirements (length, reuse, lockout) are not assessed.

mappings.title: Authenticator Management
mappings.relationship: Presence of PAM password-strength-testing libraries is partial supporting evidence for authenticator management; whether the libraries are actually configured and enforced is not verified.

mappings.title: Authenticator Management
mappings.relationship: User password-aging configuration is partial supporting evidence for authenticator management; per-user compliance is not individually verified.

mappings.title: Least Privilege
mappings.relationship: Default umask configuration is partial supporting evidence for least privilege; actual file-creation behavior across all services is not individually verified.

mappings.title: Least Privilege
mappings.relationship: General file-permissions check is partial supporting evidence for least privilege; not every security-relevant file on the system is individually reviewed here.

mappings.title: Least Privilege
mappings.relationship: Home-directory permission strictness (750 or tighter) is partial supporting evidence for least privilege; it does not assess directory contents or ACLs.

mappings.title: System Use Notification
mappings.relationship: Local login-banner (/etc/issue) content is partial supporting evidence for system-use notification; exact legal wording and approval are not verified.

mappings.title: System Use Notification
mappings.relationship: Remote login-banner (/etc/issue.net) content is partial supporting evidence for system-use notification; exact legal wording and approval are not verified.

mappings.title: Access Enforcement
mappings.relationship: GRUB boot-password presence is partial supporting evidence for access enforcement at boot time; password strength and physical security are not assessed.

mappings.title: Access Enforcement
mappings.relationship: AppArmor-enabled status is partial supporting evidence for access enforcement; individual profile coverage and enforcement mode are not verified.

mappings.title: Configuration Settings
mappings.relationship: systemd-analyze security output is partial supporting evidence for configuration hardening; results are advisory and not independently validated here.

mappings.title: Configuration Settings
mappings.relationship: Kernel sysctl hardening-parameter checks are partial supporting evidence for configuration-settings management; only the parameters in Lynis's own profile are checked.

mappings.title: Configuration Settings
mappings.relationship: PHP allow_url_fopen configuration is partial supporting evidence for configuration-settings hardening; other PHP security settings are not checked by this test.

mappings.title: Denial of Service Protection
mappings.relationship: Separate /tmp, /home, /var mount points are partial supporting evidence for DoS protection against disk-fill attacks; no load-based or network-layer DoS protection is assessed.

mappings.title: Denial of Service Protection
mappings.relationship: Apache evasive-module presence is partial supporting evidence for DoS protection at the web-server layer; module configuration and effectiveness are not verified.

mappings.title: Least Functionality
mappings.relationship: Compiler-permission restriction is partial supporting evidence for least functionality; other attack-tool categories are not assessed by this check.

mappings.title: Least Functionality
mappings.relationship: rsh-client absence is partial supporting evidence for least functionality (removing unnecessary, insecure legacy services); other legacy clients are checked by separate tests.

mappings.title: Least Functionality
mappings.relationship: TFTP-client absence is partial supporting evidence for least functionality; TFTP is unauthenticated and unencrypted by design.

mappings.title: Least Functionality
mappings.relationship: TFTP-server absence is partial supporting evidence for least functionality; TFTP is unauthenticated and unencrypted by design.

mappings.title: Least Functionality
mappings.relationship: Available network-protocol-module inventory is partial supporting evidence for least functionality; whether unused protocols are actually disabled is not verified by this check alone.

mappings.title: Malicious Code Protection
mappings.relationship: Malware-scanner presence is partial supporting evidence for malicious-code protection; scanner configuration, signature freshness, and scan scheduling are not verified.

mappings.title: Boundary Protection
mappings.relationship: Apache security-module presence is partial supporting evidence for boundary protection; rule sets and enforcement are not verified.

mappings.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
mappings.relationship: nginx SSL/TLS configuration is partial supporting evidence for transmission confidentiality/integrity; cipher strength and certificate validity are not independently re-verified here.

mappings.title: Media Use
mappings.relationship: FireWire-storage-disabled status is partial supporting evidence for media-use restriction; other removable-media types are checked by separate tests (e.g. USB-1000).

mappings.title: Media Use
mappings.relationship: USB-storage-disabled status is partial supporting evidence for media-use restriction; other removable-media types are checked by separate tests (e.g. STRG-1846).

mappings.title: Flaw Remediation
mappings.relationship: Package-audit-tool presence is partial supporting evidence for flaw remediation; it does not confirm the tool is run or that findings are acted on.

mappings.title: Flaw Remediation
mappings.relationship: Automatic-upgrade-toolkit presence is partial supporting evidence for flaw remediation; it does not confirm upgrades are actually applied or tested before deployment.
